reason_codes.meaning: Exact Legal Supplement No. 1 evidence proves Ordinance enactment/publication and routes the candidate item to identity and text-evidence processing.
Exact Legal Supplement No. 2 evidence proves publication of subsidiary legislation and routes the candidate item onward.
Exact Legal Supplement No. 2 or enabling-authority-bound Main Gazette evidence proves publication of a notice, not its legal effect.
Legal Supplement No. 3 is retained only for complete Gazette inventory and excluded classification.
A special or other supplement remains discovery-only without an item-specific accepted authority rule.
Complete authentic artifact, issue, number, publication date, or required enabling authority evidence is unavailable.
A full-text publication class lacks complete authentic English and Traditional Chinese material.
The asserted publication fact is not legally available from the exact Gazette material class.
The claimed publication occurred after the frozen observation cutoff.
Source authority, authenticity, artifact, issue, or publication evidence conflicts.
